# GoalWorld

> GoalWorld · World of Achievements — books, stadium and AI cinema in one living
> world. Read Fractured Code, play World Cup 2026 matchday on Solana, and watch
> The Neural Wars come alive.

## Pages

- [Home](https://goalworld.fun/): the GoalWorld overview, canon, cinema and Play CTA.
- [Book — Fractured Code](https://goalworld.fun/book.html): Book 1 of The Neural Wars (G2 signed off, in release preparation) with free Chapter 1 preview at `/book.html#sample`.
- [AI Cinema](https://goalworld.fun/cinema.html): official cinematic trailer, AI film-draft clips, 6-step pipeline and festival holdback notice.
- [Studio](https://goalworld.fun/studio.html): how a manuscript becomes a living world, Living Canon engine, slate and author cohort.
- [Live board](https://goalworld.fun/live.html): runtime feed of studio projects, hackathons, books and film.
- [Collectors & creators](https://goalworld.fun/collect.html): provenance-first plan for signed media and editions (no token sale, no yield).
- [About & lore](https://goalworld.fun/about.html): Neo-Citania, the Link, and the world of The Neural Wars.
- [Roadmap](https://goalworld.fun/roadmap.html): what is live today, what is next, and what comes later — deliberately no dates.
- [FAQ](https://goalworld.fun/faq.html): what GoalWorld is, how GoalChain Play works, and what the demo does and does not do.
- [Press kit](https://goalworld.fun/press.html): logos, key art, covers and screenshots.
- [Privacy](https://goalworld.fun/privacy.html) and [Terms](https://goalworld.fun/terms.html): plain-language legal pages.

## Play app

- [GoalWorld Play](https://play.goalworld.fun/): tactical football simulation sandbox on Solana Devnet (free to play, no real money).
- [GoalWorld Play llms.txt](https://play.goalworld.fun/llms.txt): the play app's agent index.

## Notes for agents

- goalworld.fun is a static site; the play app at play.goalworld.fun is a
  client-side single-page app that needs a Solana wallet connection for
  account creation and wallet-gated sections.
